description: A CarlNotes topic's findings closest to a query, ranked by meaning over the same index Carl's chat uses. Use it when the user asks Carl or CarlNotes about something on one topic, with phrases like search this topic, or what does Carl have on.

cursor.description: The cursor a previous page returned.

topic_id.description: The topic's id. Optional on a topic-bound server, which already knows its topic.
